system.description: The miniature skull of a horse hangs suspended from a leather cord. The cord is strung about with feathers, bones, teeth, and other primitive talismans. The skull is marked with red, either blood or paint, difficult to tell. Encumbrance: | At the start of each session when fortune points are awarded, the wearer of the Foal’s Head Charm gains 1 additional fortune point. However, the wearer suffers 1 {Dm} to all Charm checks while the horse skull is visible.
